protocol: Four crossover bouts on a treadmill or ergometer of 50 min each: high-volume low-intensity (<80% HRmax), pyramidal, threshold (70-80% VO2max) and HIIT (>85% HRmax); HR mean and peak, VE, VO2 and energy expenditure
population: 45 sedentary college students (26 M, 19 F), about 23 y
note: Intensity prescribed by HRmax, but VO2 and kcal are measured so dose can be absolute; no blood markers.
